class.name: AudioMixerLayout
class.brief_description: A list of [AudioMixerChannel] definitions for the [AudioMixerServer].
class.description: An [AudioMixerLayout] holds the channel definitions of a project. Edit it in the Inspector, save it as a [code].tres[/code] file and set its path in the project setting [code]audio/mixer/default_layout[/code]; the [AudioMixerServer] loads it on its first use. A layout can also be loaded at any time with [method AudioMixerServer.load_layout].

method.name: find_channel
method.description: Returns the first channel whose [member AudioMixerChannel.channel_name] is [param name], or [code]null[/code] if there is none.

members.member: The channel definitions. If two channels have the same name, the later one replaces the earlier one when the layout is loaded.
